item.name: Bunny
item.tamingRequirement: Old Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame once and feed 1 Carrot.
item.steps: Complete 1 taming minigame, then feed 1 Carrot.
item.spawnNotes: Fandom lists The Forest level 0-3 campfire, plus Farm and Bunny Burrow spawns.
item.benefit: Lowest-cost tame and the safest early way to practice the minigame.
item.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
item.risk: Runs away when damaged or approached; keep other tamed animals from hitting it while taming.

item.name: Kiwi
item.tamingRequirement: Old Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame once and feed 1 Berry.
item.steps: Complete 1 taming minigame, then feed 1 Berry.
item.location: Kiwi Burrow near Campfire Level 6 areas
item.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Campfire Level 6 - Kiwi Burrow; PC Gamer describes Kiwi as rare and not available in every match.
item.benefit: A low-food tame that is mainly valuable because it is rare and helps with taming completion/XP goals.
item.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
item.risk: Rare spawn; do not plan a run around finding it unless the burrow appears.

item.name: Green Frog
item.tamingRequirement: Old Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame twice and feed 1 Mackerel after each success.
item.steps: Repeat 2 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Mackerel.
item.spawnNotes: Fandom lists The Forest and Jungle Biome, with ponds and Frog Cave as locations. Older source copy ties frogs to pond emergence after a run timer.
item.benefit: An Old Flute tame tied to pond/frog routing, useful when the run gives frog access.
item.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
item.risk: Frogs can poison players and may not appear in every run.

item.name: Scorpion
item.tamingRequirement: Old Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame twice and feed 1 Steak plus 1 Morsel after each success.
item.steps: Repeat 2 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Steak and 1 Morsel.
item.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Volcanic Biome level 2+ campfire, with Scorpion Nest and Scorpion Pit locations.
item.benefit: A stronger Old Flute target for volcanic routes once the player can handle poison risk.
item.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
item.risk: Hostile and poison-capable; clear nearby threats before starting the minigame.

item.name: Wolf
item.tamingRequirement: Old Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame three times and feed 1 Steak plus 1 Morsel after each success.
item.steps: Repeat 3 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Steak and 1 Morsel.
item.location: The Forest, night biomes, Locked Cave #1, Large Cabin
item.spawnNotes: Fandom lists The Forest level 2+ campfire and any other biome at night. Guard and night-spawned variants need caution.
item.benefit: The first practical combat-style tame most players can plan around with Old Flute.
item.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
item.risk: Chosen wolf must not have taken damage; guard/night-spawned variants can be unsuitable or untameable.
item.availability: Normal, with Hard Mode variant note
variantNotes: Corrupted Wolf is a Hard Mode/Rift variant with the same Old Flute, 3-stage, Steak x3 and Morsel x3 requirement. Parent direction keeps it as a note, not a separate row.

item.name: Boar
item.food: Morsel x2 total, Corn x2 total
item.tamingRequirement: Old Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame two times and feed 1 Morsel plus 1 Corn after each success.
item.steps: Repeat 2 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Morsel and 1 Corn.
item.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Jungle Biome and no specific locations.
item.benefit: A newer Old Flute target for Jungle routes, useful if players need a tame while exploring that biome.
item.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
item.risk: Hostile Jungle animal with incomplete source stats; tame only if it has not taken damage.

item.name: Arctic Fox
item.tamingRequirement: Good Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame three times and feed 1 Steak plus 1 Chili after each success.
item.steps: Repeat 3 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Steak and 1 Chili.
item.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Snow Biome level 2+ campfire and says it can spawn alone or in groups.
item.benefit: A Good Flute target for snow routes, with lower listed damage than Alpha Wolf but easier biome identity.
item.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
item.risk: Often appears in packs, so clear or separate nearby foxes before taming.

item.name: Alpha Wolf
item.food: Steak x4, Mackerel x4, Salmon x4
item.tamingRequirement: Good Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame four times and feed 1 Steak, 1 Mackerel, and 1 Salmon after each success.
item.steps: Repeat 4 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Steak, 1 Mackerel, and 1 Salmon.
item.location: The Forest, night biomes, Locked Cave #2, Cultist Hunter Camp
item.biome: The Forest; any biome at night
item.spawnNotes: Fandom lists The Forest level 3+ campfire and any other biome at level 3+ campfire during night.
item.benefit: A stronger wolf-style tame with higher listed HP, damage, speed, and detection range than Wolf.
item.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
item.risk: Needs fish plus steak over four stages; night-spawned alpha wolves can be unsuitable or untameable.
item.availability: Normal, with Hard Mode variant note
variantNotes: Corrupted Alpha Wolf is a Hard Mode/Rift variant with the same Good Flute, 4-stage, Steak x4, Mackerel x4, and Salmon x4 requirement. Parent direction keeps it as a note, not a separate row.

item.name: Bear
item.food: Steak x5, Pumpkin x5, Salmon x5
item.tamingRequirement: Strong Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame five times and feed 1 Steak, 1 Pumpkin, and 1 Salmon after each success.
item.steps: Repeat 5 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Steak, 1 Pumpkin, and 1 Salmon.
item.location: The Forest level 5-6, Cultist Hunter Camp, Locked Caves
item.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Forest level 5 and 6 campfire, plus Cultist Hunter Camp and Locked Caves.
item.benefit: A high-HP, high-damage forest tame for players who have upgraded past Good Flute.
item.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit. Zookeeper class at max level may reduce repeats per Fandom note.
item.risk: Expensive five-stage tame; prepare all food before starting.

item.name: Polar Bear
item.food: Rib x5, Stew x5, Swordfish x5
item.tamingRequirement: Strong Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame five times and feed 1 Rib, 1 Stew, and 1 Swordfish after each success.
item.steps: Repeat 5 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Rib, 1 Stew, and 1 Swordfish.
item.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Snow Biome and Polar Bear Cave; older Forest/Snowy Patch locations are marked formerly.
item.benefit: A high-damage Strong Flute target for snow routing.
item.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
item.risk: One of the most expensive rows because it needs fish plus cooked food over five stages.

item.name: Mammoth
item.tamingRequirement: Strong Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame five times and feed 2 Pumpkins plus 1 Cake after each success.
item.steps: Repeat 5 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 2 Pumpkins and 1 Cake.
item.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Snow Biome; PC Gamer also lists Snow.
item.benefit: A very tanky Strong Flute target with knockback behavior once provoked.
item.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
item.risk: Requires a large pumpkin and cake stockpile; neutral until attacked, so do not let pets start the fight while setting up.

item.name: Hellephant
item.tamingRequirement: Strong Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame five times and feed 2 Pumpkins plus 1 Cake after each success.
item.steps: Repeat 5 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 2 Pumpkins and 1 Cake.
item.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Volcanic Biome and Hellephant Ritual Circle, guarded by cultists.
item.benefit: A mammoth-style Strong Flute target for Volcanic Biome routes.
item.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
item.risk: Guarded volcanic route and expensive five-stage pumpkin/cake requirement.

item.name: Mossy Mammoth
item.tamingRequirement: Strong Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame five times and feed 2 Pumpkins plus 1 Cake after each success.
item.steps: Repeat 5 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 2 Pumpkins and 1 Cake.
item.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Jungle Biome level 4+ campfire.
item.benefit: A Jungle variant of the mammoth-style Strong Flute target with the same pumpkin/cake planning burden.
item.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
item.risk: High-food Strong Flute target in the Jungle Biome; source text is typo-heavy, so keep copy tied to the verified flute, food, stage, HP, damage, and biome facts.
